mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production over a 3-month period signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies struggle with input shortages and rising costs.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 55% of periods following a 3-month INDPRO decline of > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market and slowing consumer demand, which will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence rises significantly (Conference Board index up > 5 points) in the month following the UNRATE trigger.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts decline by more than 10% year-over-year while the federal funds rate is above 4%, it signals a demand-driven slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Housing starts rebound by > 5% in the 3 months following the initial decline.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening yield curve, as measured by the spread between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, signals impending monetary tightening that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve steepens by > 30bps in the month following the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Real retail sales growth accelerating by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals a strengthening consumer sector that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Real retail sales growth decelerates by > 1% qoq in the quarter following the signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls grow by more than 300,000 jobs in a month while the unemployment rate is below 5%, it signals an overheating labor market that will lead to wage inflation and negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 300k in 1 month AND UNRATE < 5%
failure_condition: Average hourly earnings growth slows by > 0.5% yoy in the quarter following the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the consumer price index, rising by more than 0.5% month-over-month, signals a surge in inflation that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in higher future interest rates.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises by < 0.2% in the month following the trigger, indicating the inflation surge was transitory.
